description: Browse the BCA entity registry (about 150 entities: chains, projects, people and tickers), most mentioned first. Filter by kind; page with offset. Partial when none of the listed dossiers has a summary or mentions yet.

kind.description: Kind filter. chain, project, person and ticker hold entities; protocol, exchange and fund hold none yet and answer unseeded.

offset.description: Entities to skip, for paging (default 0). meta.pageInfo.hasNextPage says whether more exist.

name: list_entities
